text: トゲで　きずつきながら　そだてられた　ひなの　ハネは　かたくなる。

structure.jp: トゲで　きずつきながら
そだてられた　ひなの　ハネは
structure.en: the wings of chicks that were raised

patterns.name: 〜ながら
patterns.explanation: ながら after a verb means 'while doing' it, at the same time as something else. きずつきながら = 'while getting hurt'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: られる turns the verb around so the thing is done to someone. そだてられた = 'was raised'.

patterns.name: 〜くなる
patterns.explanation: An い-word changed to く plus なる means 'become' that way. かたくなる = 'become hard'.
